data.gender_notes: Sharha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', which means 'shining', 'radiant', or 'auspicious'. In Hinduism, the goddess Shri, or Lakshmi, is often depicted as a golden, radiant deity, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Sharha carries the meaning “Shining, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharha usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the power of the radiant and auspicious goddess Shri, Sharha signifies the presence of divine light and prosperity in one's life.
